description: Metadata for the pilot run bundled in results/raw/ and results/summary.json. run.mjs overwrites results/last-run-meta.json on every invocation (it only reflects the most recent partial run), so this file is the durable record of what actually produced the committed raw results.
grading: deterministic requiredTerms keyword match only (gradeKeywordMatch) — the LLM-judge path in lib/grader.mjs (gradeLlmJudge) exists but was NOT exercised in this pilot; see README-FIXTURE.txt.
fixtureBrain: isolated, outside the repo (LAZYBRAIN_FIXTURE_BRAIN), built by scripts/build-fixture-brain.mjs from the exact corpusDirs in questions.json — see results/fixture-build-report.json for the real indexing timings (0 LLM calls, $0).
commandsToReproduce: cd engine && npm run build   # only if dist/bin/lazybrain.js is stale
